flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Notice/{form/NoticeBasicForm,hook/useNoticeSubmit}.tsx, utils/mapping/Notice/Notice.ts. ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core/{CreateNoticeController,CreateNoticeServiceImpl}, core/helpers/{NoticeNumberHelper,NoticeValidationHelper,NoticeRecordHelper,SpecialVehUtils}, utilities/SubsystemLabelUtils, crud/ocmsizdb/sequence/SequenceRepository. ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not part of the staff create-notice path (CES/REPCCS/PLUS use other paths)
note: Status in stories.json: 'Fully paid'; the requirement is clear in the story text. Notice number and type were checked on the staff-create-notice path. The notice number is generated correctly (per-owner OCMS sequence, 1+3+5+check digit format) and code 004 identifies the OCMS source. Gaps: the notice type is not decided automatically (the dropdown offers only O and the server uses the value sent by the UI), and the source code 004 comes from the UI, is not enforced by the server, and is also used by the bulk upload. The official pre-defined criteria and the URA number-format specification are not in the repo. Whether sequence seq_notice_no_ocms and standard code 004 exist in the database: cannot verify from repo. Tickets: OCMS-SR-2026-101 and OCMS-DF-2026-102 (UPL, Closed, changed type X defaults, already in code); OCMS-DF-2026-100 and OCMS-DEV-2026-057 are only perf/hardening changes around the sequence and do not change the verdict.
recommendation: Claim partially. Unique number and format exist. Ask URA to confirm automatic type selection and the pre-defined criteria, or mark them as a gap; consider having the server set subsystemLabel 004 for the staff endpoint.

steps.step: Officer fills in the Create Notice form in the staff portal and submits; OCMS validates mandatory fields
steps.detail: After the officer submits the Create Notice form, the UI calls POST staff-create-notice (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:37,49-51), which reaches CreateNoticeController.handleStaffNotice (:34-38) and then processStaffCreateNotice -> processNoticeWithDtoMapping. validateMandatoryFieldsForBatch rejects a notice that lacks a mandatory field (for example offenceNoticeType, NoticeValidationHelper.java:140-142). This trigger step matches the story.

steps.step: OCMS decides the parking offence notice type (O/E/U) automatically from pre-defined criteria
steps.detail: The notice type is not chosen automatically. The dropdown in NoticeBasicForm.tsx:118 offers only option O (OFFENCE_TYPE.filter value === 'O'), the UI sends it as offenceNoticeType (Notice.ts:265), and the server stores it unchanged (NoticeRecordHelper.java:737). The server does look up the offense type from offence_rule_code (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:967-972), but the result is used only for the AN check (:1175), not to select the notice type. The E and U forms exist in the UI but cannot be selected from the dropdown. No pre-defined criteria for choosing the type were found.

steps.step: OCMS checks pre-defined criteria (vehicle type, duplicates) so the notice is created with the right treatment
steps.detail: The server does run automatic criteria on create: a blank or N.A plate becomes vehicle type X (UPL) (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:1015-1018), otherwise SpecialVehUtils.checkVehregistration decides D/I/V/S/F (SpecialVehUtils.java:43-92), then processing stages are set per type (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:1143-1151), plus duplicate and PS-DBB checks. However the story does not list the criteria and says 'correct type of notice', so the match with the URA criteria cannot be proven from the repo. Tickets OCMS-SR-2026-101 and OCMS-DF-2026-102 (UPL Notice Creation, Closed) fixed the default payment flag and composition amount for type X, so this behaviour was wrong before and was only corrected later; the official criteria list: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS generates a unique notice number for the manual notice
steps.detail: When noticeNo is empty, NoticeNumberHelper.processNoticeNumber builds a new number (NoticeNumberHelper.java:32-61). The running part comes from a per-owner DB sequence: sequenceService.getNextNoticeNumber (:99) -> SELECT NEXT VALUE FOR ocmsizmgr.seq_notice_no_<owner> (SequenceRepository.java:65-68), formatted to 5 digits (:102). The number is generated before the INSERT (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:1192-1195), and a duplicate noticeNo is rejected (checkDuplicateNoticeNumber, :925). Uniqueness depends on the database sequence; whether sequence seq_notice_no_ocms exists in the environment: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The notice number follows the pre-defined format (year + subsystem + running number + check digit)
steps.detail: The number format is built in NoticeNumberHelper.java:49-61: last digit of the year + 3-digit subsystem + 5-digit running number + 1 check character (10 in total). The check digit uses Modulo 11 with weights {1,2,3,4,5,10,9,8,7} and a letter mapping (:129-143). The format is consistent with the example in the comment (600400015H), but the official URA format specification is not in the repo, so conformance to it: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The notice number shows the source and that the notice was created manually in OCMS
steps.detail: The UI always sends subsystemLabel '004' (Notice.ts:289), so the number carries code 004 and the subsystem_label column is filled (NoticeRecordHelper.java:755); 004 maps to owner OCMS via standard code SUB_SYSTEM_LABEL (SubsystemLabelUtils.java:38-71). The gap: the label is decided by the client, not the server. processStaffCreateNotice (CreateNoticeServiceImpl.java:181-183) does not require the label to be 004, so a request that sends another label is still processed as long as the label exists in the standard code. Code 004 is also used by the XLSX upload, so it does not separate 'one-by-one manual' from 'bulk upload'. Whether standard code 004=OCMS exists is database content: cannot verify from repo.
